feeds.title: The Stingy Vegan
feeds.description: I am Melissa and I am stingy. I hate spending money. I am vegan. Meat is expensive and beans are cheap! If you're living (or considering) a plant-based lifestyle and you're on a budget or stingy like me, you're in the right place. I'll break down the total cost and cost per serving of each of my recipes to show any naysayer that a vegan diet isn't expensive!

feeds.title: Cheap Lazy Vegan Blog
feeds.description: My name is Rose - just an ordinary girl born in South Korea and raised in the beautiful country of Canada. Cheap Lazy Vegan Blog is for people who are cheap, lazy, and interested in the vegan lifestyle. Covers easy and affordable vegan meal ideas, low-calorie vegan recipes, Korean recipes, Asian recipes, vegan snacks, and vegan breakfast.

feeds.title: The Minimalist Vegan
feeds.description: We're Michael and Masa! Minimalist Vegan is a resource to bring you delicious vegan recipes using approachable everyday ingredients. We publish recipes, lifestyle articles, cooking videos, and host a podcast to help you live with less stuff and more compassion.

feeds.title: Frugal Vegan Mom
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kelly. Know about frugality, how to do it, the actual savings reports, and insight into the frugal lifestyle at Frugal Vegan Mom blog.

feeds.title: Well Vegan » Budget Vegan
feeds.description: Get the healthy, affordable vegan recipes and meal plans. Frugal, cheap, easy, tasty, and quick? We've got you covered. Here's a collection of our favorite budget vegan recipes.

feeds.title: VegCharlotte » Frugal Vegan
feeds.description: I'm Catherine - an imperfect and practical vegan living in Charlotte, North Carolina. Find the easy vegan recipes and frugal vegan updates at VegCharlotte.
